clips.title: The story
paras: Past the Valley of Heroes, Trade District draws Stormwind’s merchants and travelers. Its bank, Auction House, guild registry, and shops serve citizens and adventurers alike.

You pass beneath the stone arches from the Valley of Heroes into Trade District. The open plaza is Stormwind’s main marketplace and a hub for goods and travel. The Auction House stands at its center, with the Stormwind Counting House, the city’s main bank, and The Gilded Rose nearby. From here, routes lead to Old Town, the Cathedral Square, and the Mage Quarter. Coin, raw goods, and supplies for adventurers pass through the district on their way across the realm.

Shops line the paved avenues and canals, offering goods for daily needs and travel. Weller’s Arsenal and Lionheart Armory sell blades and mail, while The Empty Quiver offers bows. Stalls sell fresh flowers and aged vintages from the Gallina Winery. Just inside the gates, the Stormwind Visitor’s Center handles newly registered guild charters and tabard designs. On the eastern side, an elevated ramp leads to the Gryphon Roost, connecting Stormwind’s markets with Alliance territories.
